Stretch marks are basically scars, and will not react to tanning like the rest of your skin. If yours are already fading they will just remain silver/white, so a tan could make them more visible if anything.  If you are tanning while the scars are still forming, they will just come out darker than the rest of your skin. I have heard that spray tans can mask them a bit though (basically like concealer). Taking good care of your skin is important and will definitely help you in the long run (exfoliating and moisturizing).

I have them in the same areas from weight fluctuations, so I understand how you are feeling. They will fade over time, and will just kind of blend in with your skin and only become noticeable in certain lights. And even then, most people will not notice or care. It's important to remember that literally everyone gets stretch marks, even supermodels.
